title: NBA Over/Under Step 2 — Data Source + API Foundation
scope: Activate a protected NBA DevSystem lane and add an NBA-only normalized schedule and totals-market data boundary. No public route, app entrypoint, shared API, model, projection, probability, ranking, selection, or other-sport product changes are authorized in Step 2. One narrowly scoped shared DevSystem workflow edit is authorized only to register and aggregate the NBA critical lane.

verifier_setup_failure.root_cause: The dedicated Step-2 workflow did not install pytest, so the contract never executed.
verifier_setup_failure.patch: Install pytest in the dedicated proof workflow before running the contract.

valid_tdd_red.root_cause: The Step-2 contract imported nba_data_foundation_v1 before the implementation existed.

devsystem_integration_blocker.root_cause: The NBA manifest became active with critical_job nba-step2-data-foundation, but devsystem-targeted-ci.yml did not yet contain that job marker or aggregate the lane.
devsystem_integration_blocker.observed_failure: PermanentGateFailure: targeted CI permanent markers missing: job:nba-step2-data-foundation
devsystem_integration_blocker.patch: Add one NBA Step-2 critical job and aggregate only its result in PR fast, merged-main, and final-gate policy.

concurrent_scope_drift.root_cause: Concurrent commits on superseded PR 1395 expanded Step 2 into sports_api route/provider/shared-health surfaces outside the authorized NBA data-foundation boundary.
concurrent_scope_drift.resolution: Close PR 1395 unmerged, preserve its history for audit, and continue from the last clean approved tree on replacement PR 1396 without shared API expansion.

tdd.red_result: pytest reached collection and failed exactly because nba_data_foundation_v1 did not exist
